title: A Global Fiscal Indicators Dashboard
subtitle: Eighty public indicators, one country profile, and a build anyone can rerun
message: A one-page fiscal and energy profile for 217 economies from about twenty public datasets, rebuilt by a script that never imputes, records the year and source of every value and stops if configuration and output disagree.

problem.title: Every analysis starts with a scramble

stats.label: indicators in twelve blocks, scored 1 to 10
public datasets, each with its own names and vintages

problem.text: Debt, tax take, capital execution, cost of capital, subsidies and the power mix sit in different databases. Assembling them takes a day per country and a week per region, and the next analyst starts again.

mechanism.title: The profile separates different problems
mechanism.caption: 2024 values from IMF WoRLD and WEO, as compiled by the pipeline.
points: Indonesia: a revenue problem; subsidies of 3% of GDP.
South Africa: a debt-service problem and the largest implicit subsidies.
No overall index: the triage is the point.

action.title: Use it to choose the next question
results: Every value carries its year and source file.
Vintages run from 2013 to 2025; coverage is uneven.
The same panel feeds the scenario tool (6.5).
